title: Entity-level docstring conventions as used in IDE/assistant workflows
description: New practice axis. Replaces the vendor document-set style guide with entity-level conventions that assistant tools follow per language. Anchors are intentionally left incomplete pending calibration (S5).

criteria.name: Signature Conformance
criteria.definition: The described name, parameter order, and types match the actual signature.

criteria.name: Parameter Coverage
criteria.definition: Every parameter is described, including defaults and constraints.

criteria.name: Return Documentation
criteria.definition: Return values are described, including empty/None/void cases.

criteria.name: Exception Documentation
criteria.definition: Thrown exceptions or error codes are described.

criteria.name: Side-effect & State Documentation
criteria.definition: Side effects, state mutation, and I/O are described.

criteria.name: Inheritance/Polymorphism Contract
criteria.definition: For classes and overridden methods, the inheritance chain, override obligations, and polymorphic contract are described.

criteria.name: Dependency Context
criteria.definition: Relevant callers, callees, or collaborators are described.

criteria.name: Usage Example Validity
criteria.definition: Any example is runnable and consistent with the signature.

criteria.name: Language Convention Adherence
criteria.definition: The artifact follows the target language's docstring convention (Google Style/PEP 257, JSDoc/TSDoc, Javadoc).
